title: Deduplicate scheduled jobs by idempotency key
author: norvik

reviews.author: mcairn
reviews.body: Approving the rest of the change; thread 3 still stands.

comments.author: quill-bot
comments.body: Index creation without `CONCURRENTLY` will lock the jobs table during the deploy.

comments.author: norvik
comments.body: Fixed — the migration now creates the index `CONCURRENTLY`.

comments.author: mcairn
comments.body: Dropped duplicates should be observable, or support will chase ghost jobs.

comments.author: mcairn
comments.body: The check-then-insert here isn't atomic. Two workers picking up the same key inside the window both pass `exists_within_window` before either inserts. I reproduced it locally with two workers and a 5 ms stagger: both executed the job body. The unique index stops the second row, but by then the work has run twice — which is the exact bug this PR exists to prevent.

comments.author: norvik
comments.body: Good catch — will look at this later, don't want to hold the merge on it.
